marker.speaker: narrator
marker.text: A Beacon-crew marker, Ostrand's sign scratched under it, and under that, in six different hands, the same seven notes. The trail goes deeper than this Shard goes.

tune.speaker: cinder
tune.text: A fifth. The Choir's interval. They were being taught to sing before they were taken. I was taught the same way, four hundred years ago, and I went.

signal.speaker: kaj7
signal.text: Yes. Written down. I did not know it could be written down. That is worse, somehow.
